faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate-II position at AIIMS Bhopal is 15 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-II position at AIIMS Bhopal as per the current recruitment notification released for the CCRH funded research project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences to be eligible for the Project Associate-II position. Preference will be given to those with relevant research experience in academic or scientific organizations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Associate-II recruitment. All categories of candidates can apply for this position free of cost as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-II position is 45 years. Please ensure you meet this age criteria as of the date specified in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection be conducted for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II post involves the shortlisting of received applications followed by an interview. The interview may be conducted in either online or offline mode depending on the institute's requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-II post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- plus 20% HRA, in accordance with the ANRF guidelines provided in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No, you are strictly instructed not to send a hard copy of the application form. All applications must be submitted electronically via email to the address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Associate-II recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to download the form from the official website and send the scanned documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be found on the AIIMS Bhopal official website at www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in under the jobs section. You can also refer to the links provided in this article for direct access.
